name: codex-threadgraph
description: Build evidence-backed relationship graphs from Codex thread context.

interface.shortDescription: Map and navigate relationships between Codex threads.
interface.longDescription: Builds a local, evidence-backed context graph from Codex threads so users can understand lineage, shared topics, decisions, conflicts, and specialization before choosing a thread.
interface.defaultPrompt: Map the relevant Codex threads for this project and explain their relationships with evidence.
